prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a wordless wide landscape comic establishing view, matching the polished soft glossy magical 3D style of this project. Edit and reinterpret reference 1's star system composition: put PLANET POP STAR at the exact center of its concentric sparkling elliptical orbital paths, replacing the central castle. Planet Pop Star must look exactly like reference 3: a plump golden five-point star-shaped planet, tiny shallow star dimples, warm golden glow and two crossing sparkling white rings. Make it the main central focus, about 28 percent of frame width, fully visible, NOT a spherical sun.
Keep the wonderfully whimsical star system from reference 1, with clearly separated three concentric elliptical trails of multicolored stardust and its recognizable toy-like orbiting worlds: rainbow-ringed pastel planet on left, cyan/pink round world lower left, winged golden present with pink ribbon in foreground, turquoise lightning-shaped world on right, pink crescent with blue star, floating jewel cards, pastel bunny-like little moon, pink/gold checkerboard planet, tiny colorful ringed planets on the upper arcs. Preserve their broad arrangement and visual character; uncluttered readable spacing and depth. Dark sapphire and violet nebula backdrop, little colored sparkles.
Move the princess castle into the DISTANT BACKGROUND, above and slightly right of central Pop Star, well behind the farthest orbit. Use reference 2 for its architecture: pastel pink, lavender, mint and blue slender turrets with pointed pink roofs, gold gates and trim, star/heart details, a floating rock island surrounded by soft white clouds and a small luminous rainbow bridge/waterfall. Keep the castle recognizable and wholly visible, about 18 percent of frame width, smaller and less bright than central Pop Star, atmospheric distance. It must not sit ON Pop Star or obscure the central star silhouette, and there is only ONE castle. No large foreground characters, no new story actions. No writing, labels, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, watermark, or panel borders. Wide 16:9 composition, all major worlds fully inside frame. Image 1 is the star-system layout edit target, image 2 castle detail reference, image 3 the established Pop Star design and finish.
